title.en: An Act Creating the Barrio of Nasumi in the Municipality of Dingle, Province of Iloilo
title.orig: An Act Creating the Barrio of Nasumi in the Municipality of Dingle, Province of Iloilo
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập một Barrio Nasumi tại Đô thị Dingle, Tỉnh Iloilo
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งบาริโอ Nasumi ในเทศบาล Dingle จังหวัด Iloilo
title.id: Undang-Undang membentuk sebuah Barrio Nasumi di Kotamadya Dingle, Provinsi Iloilo
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan sebuah Barrio Nasumi di Perbandaran Dingle, Wilayah Iloilo

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1954/ra_1011_1954.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The sitio of Nasumi in the municipality of Dingle, Province of Iloilo, is hereby converted into a new barrio in the same municipality to be known as the barrio of Nasumi.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 12, 1954.
